title: Extract the duplicated record parser
prompt: importers/csv_import.py and importers/tsv_import.py each carry their own copy of the record validation logic. Extract it into a new module importers/records.py exposing parse_record(fields, lineno), use it from both importers, and remove the duplicated private functions. Behaviour, including every error message, must stay exactly the same, and the existing tests in tests/ must keep passing without changes.
